answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on four text generation datasets with diverse tasks and domains: • E2E ... • CommonGen ... • SAMSum ... • ROCStories ...
answer_1.outputs: generated texts for each dataset (e.g., fluent sentences, summaries, stories)

answer_2.quote: We adopt five automatic metrics, namely BLEU, ROUGE, CIDEr, SPICE, and Distinct, to compare the performance of different methods.

answer_4.quote: We further invite five college students to assess the generated texts. The annotators should choose which one is better or choose a tie based on their subjective feelings.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which generated text is better or indicate a tie based on subjective judgment.
